title: Hand-drawn annotation and highlight kit
what_it_does: vox-annotate (settled headline plus marker note), marker-highlight, inline-highlight, hw-arrow, hw-callout-circle, hw-underline, hw-box-label, hw-boil, hw-title, hw-write-title.
when_to_use: Pointing at things on screen: circle, underline, arrow, marker swipe.
why: Official and render-tested by HyperFrames; better than writing our own. This also overlaps the highlighter swipe in Cele-san/vox-style-animation.
